title: OAuth, MCP, HTTP gateway, and public tool dispatch

previous_iteration_review.subject: feat(storage): establish persistence and capability authority [MTM-004]
previous_iteration_review.result: The committed MTM-004 gate, 52-operation storage/capability hash, historical migration rollback and implementation-bound real database-copy evidence passed before MTM-005 began.

authority.component_scope: MTM-reboot OAuth, MCP, HTTP and public tool dispatch boundary

implemented: OAuth dynamic client registration with exact redirect, grant, response and token-auth-method validation
Authorization Code plus PKCE S256 with single-use transactional codes and fixed expiration bounds
HMAC-SHA256 bearer tokens with fixed or loopback-derived issuer/audience binding
Legacy MCP 2025-11-25 and 2025-06-18 plus modern MCP 2026-07-28 request/response shaping
Modern protocol, method and tool-name mirror-header validation including base64 sentinel handling
HTTP request-size/content-type checks, OAuth challenge metadata, Origin/CORS policy and modern HTTP error mapping
Fail-closed catalog verifier for 24 ordered public tools, 11 hidden aliases, and all 35 exact definitions
ToolBackend dispatch boundary that cannot implement Native or workflow behavior
Real standalone Rust gateway server used only for target validation, with an echo backend clearly marked non-production

conformance.interpretation: A5 resource non-regression passed on a deterministic debug-build shadow workload. No A6 production performance claim is made.

coverage: Real Firefox authorization-page rendering and automatic browser form submission
DCR, PKCE, code exchange and code-reuse denial
Exact 24-tool listing and hidden alias dispatch
Legacy and modern MCP with mirror headers and HTTP status rules
MCP Origin rejection and allowed-origin CORS
Loopback reverse-proxy origin and fixed-origin precedence

failures_retained.stage: first gateway compile and lint gate
failures_retained.cause: Initial code had Axum extractor type mismatches, token-fingerprint byte/string mismatches, a guarded matches pattern, unused imports and an unconstrained JSON-RPC result type.
failures_retained.resolution: Corrected typed boundaries and handler extractors without suppressing Clippy or weakening validation.

failures_retained.cause: Rust initially stored redirect_uris_json using comma-space formatting based on an incorrect assumption; the frozen Python source stores compact JSON.
failures_retained.resolution: Restored compact source-compatible JSON; all 44 API, token, event and OAuth-row records then matched exactly.

failures_retained.cause: The first source scan treated the literal proof_verified.tex inside user instructions as artifact-publication authority.
failures_retained.resolution: Restricted the mechanical authority scan to implementation dependencies and executable authority tokens rather than documentation strings.

failures_retained.cause: Gateway dependencies changed the shared Cargo.lock, invalidating MTM-003 and MTM-004 implementation hashes.
failures_retained.resolution: Re-ran all real Native/CAS/tunnel and real copied-database/rollback target checks; new hash-bound reports passed.

failures_retained.cause: Firefox headless emitted platform diagnostics while loading and submitting the real form.
failures_retained.resolution: Stored no diagnostic text or secrets; acceptance depends on browser exit, screenshot creation, callback receipt, state binding and subsequent PKCE exchange.

acceptance.A0: passed: formatting, Clippy -D warnings, 42 Rust tests, nine governance tests, graph and Git checks
acceptance.A1: passed: exact 24/11 catalog facts, 35 definition hash, three OAuth auth methods, PKCE/token and legacy/modern MCP golden contract
acceptance.A2: passed: 44 deterministic source/Rust records with zero differences and no Git-visible shadow side effect
acceptance.A3: passed: malformed token, code reuse, mirror mismatch, duplicate header, wrong Origin, fixed/dynamic issuer, hidden-list boundary and catalog tamper tests
acceptance.A4: passed: 15 implementation-hash-bound real Rust HTTP/Firefox checks plus 19 source OAuth/MCP/HTTP tests

dependencies.review: Dependencies are lockfile-pinned. Gateway library code has no mtm-storage, mtm-native, workflow, vault or finalizer dependency; the server validation binary uses only the ToolBackend boundary.

rollback: Do not route deployed traffic to mtm-gateway, or route it back exclusively to the Python gateway before any future cutover. OAuth and workflow state formats remain source compatible, and this milestone changed no production endpoint or database writer.
